tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅: tshe dpag med sgrub pa 'chi bdag dpung 'joms bzhugs so:

dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid: gang zhig 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho 'jigs rung las: 'gro rnams ma lus sgrol ba'i ded dpon mchog: tshe dpag med dang pad 'byung rgyal gyur cig: dkyil 'khor dbus ni pad 'dab bzhi: tshe gtor bum gzugs sman rag gtor: mchod pa rnam bdun tshogs 'khor bcas: yo byad thams cad 'du byas la: dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni: sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la: bdag dang 'gro drug sems can rnams: mi phyed dad pas skyabs su mchi: sems bskyed pa ni: mtha' yas 'gro ba ma lus pa: sangs rgyas go 'phang 'thob bya'i phyir: sangs rgyas tshe dpag med bsgrub bgyi: rdo rje'i sku mchog myur thob shog: tshogs gsag pa ni: 'chi med tshe yi lha tshogs la: phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul yi rang gsol: sgo gsum mi dge mthol lo bshags: bsod nams tshogs chen rdzogs nas kyang: 'chi med rdo rje'i tshe thob shog: bgegs la bka' bsgo ba ni: hūm̐: 'khor 'das rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor cher: ma rtogs log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs: rang byung ye shes chen pos bskrad: ye stong ngang du phyir dengs shig: gdon bgegs 'byung po utstshaṭṭa ya phaṭa: srung 'khor bsgom pa ni: rdzogs chen khyab gdal rang rtsal las: 'dre gdon bya ba'i ming yang med: ma rtogs log 'dren nga bdag bgegs: tshe lhar gsal bas mtshams bcad do: badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐: byin 'beb ni: bde ba can gyi zhing khams nas: tshe lha 'khor bcas byin phob cig: byin chen rnams kyis byin phob cig: dbang chen rnams kyis dbang skur cig: rtags dang mtshan ma bstan pa dang: tshe yi dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: badzra sa ma ya ā we sha ya hūm̐: mchod pa byin rlabs ni: sman snod ka pā la yi nang du ni: zag med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por 'khyil: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: gtor gzhong rin chen padma'i snod nang du: gtor rdzas ro mchog brgya dang ldan par gyur:

oṃ ma hā ba liṃ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: dung chen bde ba chen po'i snod nang du: chags med rakta'i rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs 'khrugs: oṃ ma hā rakta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: mchod snod rin chen las grub 'od 'bar bar: mchod rdzas 'dod yon rgya mtsho'i sprin 'phror gyur: oṃ badzra arghaṃ nas shabda āḥhūm̐: bshags pa ni: bcom ldan tshe yi lha tshogs la: sgo gsum mi dge'i las rnams kun: snying nas bshags so byang nas kyang: tshe lha'i go 'phang myur thob shog: lha bskyed pa ni: sems nyid stong gsal de yi ngang: snying rje'i gdangs las hrīḥdamar gsal: e yaṃ raṃ baṃ suṃ 'phros las: rang byung 'byung ba lnga chags steng: gser gyi sa gzhi mig mang ris: bhrūm̐ las gzhal yas khang chen po: rin chen sna lnga'i rtsig pa la: gru bzhi sgo bzhi mtshan nyid rdzogs: rta babs gdugs tog nyi zlas brgyan: pho brang gzhal yas nyams dga' bar: nyi zla padma'i gdan steng du: hrīḥdamar yongs su gyur pa las: bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med: bye ru'i mdog 'dra lta na sdug: longs spyod rdzogs pa'i chas dang ldan: dbu la rigs lnga'i prog zhu gsol: dbu skra thor tshugs rus rgyan spras: zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag steng: bum pa dar gyi cod pan can: bdud rtsis gang ba dpag bsam brgyan: bsnams mdzad bde ba rgyas bzhin du: rdo rje skyil krung lam mer bzhugs: pang du yum mchog gos dkar mo: spyan mdzes 'dzum mdangs thor tshugs can: me tog dkar dmar rgyan gyis spras: phyag gnyis gri gug thod khrag bsnams: yab kyi mgul du 'khyud par mdzad: sku la dar dmar stod smad g.yogs: ratna dmar pos yab yum spras: zhabs gnyis yab kyi rked par 'khyud: spyi bo bde chen rtsa 'khor dbus: padma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: bcom ldan rdo rje tshe dpag med: spyan ma yum dang gnyis med 'khril: mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo'i dbus: padma nyi zla'i gdan steng du:

bcom ldan padma tshe dpag med: gos dkar yum dang gnyis med 'khril: snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbus: padma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: bcom ldan rnam snang tshe dpag med: dbyings phyug yum dang gnyis med 'khril: lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i dbus: padma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: bcom ldan rin chen tshe dpag med: mā kī yum dang gnyis med 'khril: gsang gnas bde skyong 'khor lo'i dbus: padma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: bcom ldan don grub tshe dpag med: dam tshig sgrol mar gnyis med 'khril: yab yum bcu po bye ru'i mdog: longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rgyan dang ldan: yab kyis phyag gnyis tshe bum 'dzin: yum gyis gri gug thod khrag bsnams: zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs:1$0000250 yab yum gnyis po bye ru'i mdog: 1$0000300 ces man gyi tshig lnga rigs lngar lan lnga yod pas spro na bya/ mchan/ shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro dkar: lho ru rin chen mkha' 'gro ser: nub tu padma mkha' 'gro dmar: byang du las kyi mkha' 'gro ljang: dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan: phyag gnyis mda' dar tshe bum bsnams: zhabs gnyis bzhengs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs: shar sgor rdo rje ber nag can: mthing nag gri gug thod khrag bsnams: sag ti'i lh+wam gsol me klong 'gying: lho sgor re tī rang byung rgyal: mthing nag gri gug thod khrag bsnams: drel rta'i steng du phyed skyil bzhugs: nub sgor bdud mgon trag shad ni: mthing nag ru dar tsitta bsnams: rta mchog bra nag rgyan ldan 'chibs: byang sgor mkha' ri dung gi mdog: phyag g.yas mdung dar g.yon sba lcag: shel rta dkar po rgyan ldan chibs: rang nyid tshe dpag med gsal ba'i: gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum dang: thugs ka'i sa bon hrīḥyig las: 'od zer phyogs bcur rab 'phros pas: bde ba can dang o rgyan yul: phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams nas: lha tshogs 'khor bcas spyan drangs te:

bdag dang dkyil 'khor la thim gyur: spyan 'dren pa ni: hrī: bde chen dag pa'i zhing khams nas: tshe dpag med mgon gos dkar mo: lha tshogs 'khor bcas spyan 'dren gshegs: o rgyan yul dang zangs mdog nas: padma 'byung gnas mtsho rgyal yum: lha tshogs 'khor bcas spyan 'dren gshegs: shar phyogs mngon dga'i zhing khams nas: rdo rje tshe dpag spyan 'dren gshegs: lho phyogs yon tan bkod zhing nas: rin chen tshe dpag spyan 'dren gshegs: nub phyogs bde chen zhing khams nas: padma tshe dpag spyan 'dren gshegs: byang phyogs las rab zhing khams nas: karma tshe dpag spyan 'dren gshegs: dbus phyogs stug po bkod zhing nas: rnam snang tshe bdag spyan 'dren gshegs: phyogs bzhi'i zhing khams dam pa nas: lha mo rnam bzhi gshegs su gsol: phrin las bzhi sgrub gzhal yas nas: sgo srung rnam bzhi gshegs su gsol: rtsa brgyud bla ma tshe lha dang: yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams: gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob cig: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi skur: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol: oṃ badzra sa ma ya dza dza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: bzhugs gsol ni: 'khor ba'i skyon bral padma'i gdan: ma rig mun sel nyi zla'i steng: ye shes tshe yi lha tshogs rnams: dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs nas kyang: tshe dbang grub par mdzad du gsol: 'chi med lha la phyag 'tshal lo: badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: a ti pū ho: pra ti dza ho: mchod 'bul ni: mchod yon yan lag brgyad ldan chu: zhabs bsil rgyun mi chad pa'i chu: dbyibs legs mtshar sdug me tog dang: dri zhim spos kyi bye brag dang: ma rig mun sel snang gsal dang: gdung ba sel ba'i dri chab dang: ro brgya ldan pa'i zhal zas dang: yid 'phrog rol mo'i sgra la sogs: mchod pa'i bye brag du ma yis: rdo rje tshe yi lha tshogs mchod: oṃ badzra arghaṃ sogs nas shabda pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya āḥhūm̐:

sman mchod 'bul ba ni: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi 'dis: rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma dang: bcom ldan tshe yi lha tshogs mchod: dgyes bzhes tshe yi dngos grub stsol: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛta khā hi: rakta 'bul ba ni: khams gsum rakta rgyun chad rdzas: zag med rakta'i bcud chen pos: 'chi med tshe yi lha tshogs mchod: dgyes bzhes tshe yi dngos grub stsol: oṃ ma hā rakṣa khā hi: gtor ma 'bul ba ni: 'bru bcud stong sbyar gtor chen po: 'chi med tshe yi lha tshogs la: ye shes lnga yi ngang du 'bul: dgyes bzhes tshe yi dngos grub stsol: oṃ ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi: bstod pa ni: bde bar gshegs pa bcom ldan 'das: skyob pa mtshungs med sangs rgyas sku: 'gro ba'i mgon po tshe dpag med: yab yum gnyis med sku la bstod: padma rā ga'i lhun po la: nyi ma'i 'od kyi mdangs chags ltar: 'gro ba'i tsha gdung sel mdzad pa: gzi brjid mtha' yas khyed la bstod: spyan gsum dus gsum sa ler gzigs: khams gsum 'khor ba dong nas sprugs: rigs lnga'i cod pan thor tshugs brgyan: 'gro drug 'dren mdzad khyed la bstod: le brgan dar gyis stod smad dkris: rjes chags 'gro ba thabs kyis 'dul: phyag gnyis tshe bum rgyan ldan bsnams: tshe yi dngos grub stsol la bstod: rin chen sna tshogs phreng bas brgyan: phrin las rnam bzhi stsol ba'i brda': pang du gos dkar bde bas dgyes: thabs shes 'du 'bral med la bstod: thor tshugs rigs lngas brgyan pa ni: sku lnga 'du 'bral med pa ste: gri gug thod khrag bsnams pa ni: gzung 'dzin skye rgyud gcod la bstod: stod g.yogs smad dkris dar dmar brgyan: chos sku skye ba med pa ste: zhabs gnyis yab kyi rked la 'khril: bde stong dbyings su 'dren la bstod: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las lha: tshe bdag lha lngas brgyan pa ni: tshe dbang dngos grub stsol la bstod: tshe yi mgyogs ma bzhugs pa ni:

tshe dbang phrin las myur 'grub bstod: sgo bzhi'i chos skyong rnam bzhi ni: phrin las rnam bzhi myur 'grub bstod: dzap bzla ba ni: rang nyid tshe dpag med gsal ba'i: thugs kar nyi steng yi ge hrī: sngags kyi phreng bas g.yas bskor bar: 'od zer phyogs bcu'i zhing du 'phros: rgyal ba mchod cing tshe bcud bsdus: thugs ka'i sa bon nyid la thim: de las 'od zer phar 'phros nas: 'gro drug tshe bsod dpal 'byor bsdus: tshe bsod gdon gyis khyer pa rnams: hrīḥdang sngags phreng nyid la thim: de yi ngang nas ci nus bzla: oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī wanti swā hā: oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzi wanti padmāka ra hūm̐ bhrūm̐ swā hā: 'khor sngags ni: oṃ bai ro tsa na oṃ: oṃ a mi ta bha hrī: oṃ akṣo bhya badzra hūm̐: oṃ ratna saṃ bha wa trāṃ: oṃ a mo gha siddhi ā: oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā: oṃ ro ru ro ru tsa pa la a shug me ma hūm̐ ma bhyo dza dza: oṃ ma hā kā la trakshad du dza: phu nā ga rā dza sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐: zhes bzla: tshe 'gugs gang rung bya/ mchan/ tshogs 'khor ni: tshogs rdzas su 'os pa 'du byas la byin gyis brlab pa ni: tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i longs spyod rnams: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis mi gtsang sbyangs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin brlabs pas: ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ha hoḥhrī: lan gsum: spyan 'dren ni: mi mngon bde chen zhing khams nas: bcom ldan tshe yi lha tshogs rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs: zangs mdog pad 'od zhing khams nas: padma 'od 'bar lha tshogs rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs: rang snang rnam dag zhing khams nas: rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs: zhing khams rnam lnga'i gzhal yas nas: tshe bdag rigs lnga'i lha tshogs rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs: tshe lha'i zhing khams rab 'byams nas:

mkha' 'gro sde lnga 'khor bcas rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs: dur khrod me ri 'bar ba nas: bdud 'dul ma mgon lha tshogs rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs: 'chi med tshe yi lha tshogs rnams: tshogs kyi mchod par gshegs mdzod la: bdag cag rdo rje mched lcam rnams: bar chad mi mthun g.yul rgyal ba'i: tshe yi dbang dang dngos grub stsol: tshogs phud 'bul ba ni: tshogs kyi mchod pa dam pa 'di: tshe lha'i tshogs la 'bul lo bzhes: bsod nams tshogs chen myur rdzogs nas: bla med byang chub thob par shog: bshags pa ni: bdag cag bag med dbang gyur pas: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig las: 'gal pa thams cad mthol lo bshags: bsgral ba ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: tshe yi lha tshogs mthu rtsal can: gnad bskul dus bab bar chad bgegs: rdul phran bzhin du brlags nas kyang: lhag ma ming tsam med par mdzod: ru tra mā ra ya phaṭa: bstab pa ni: tshe yi lha tshogs zhal phyes shig: dgra bgegs bsgral pa'i sha khrag rus: bdud rtsi'i bdag nyid zhal du bstabs: bar chad thams cad zlog par mdzod: tshogs la rol: lhag ma bsngo ba ni: lhag la dbang ba'i mkha' 'gro ma: sku mdog sngon mo spyan gsum ldan: ral pa dmar pos sku stod khyab: thod skam lnga yis dbu rgyan byas: zhing chen pags pas stod dkris byas: gri gug thod khrag phyag na bsnams: stag lpags sham thabs mi mgo'i phreng: lcags spyang mgo dgu rta ru zhon: yid ni dam tshig ldan la brtse: ngag nas shugs glu tsir tsir sgrog: lhag ma'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sangs rgyas bstan pa spel ba dang: bla ma'i sku dgra khyed kyis sgrol: ma g.yel tshe yi srung ma mdzod: bcol pa'i phrin las myur 'grub mdzod: chad mdo ni: hūm̐: sngon 'das dus nas da lta yan chad bar: tshe dpag med mgon o rgyan yab yum gyis: sprul pa yang sprul rig 'dzin sras bcas la: ji ltar so sos khas blangs dam bcas chad: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la:

dge bsnyen nyer gcig dkar phyogs yul lha rnams: kha 'dzin sdongs grogs rgyab rten ma g.yel bar: rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod: brtan ma ni: sngon tshe 'das dus bskal pa'i thog ma la: chos rgyal tshangs pa lha yi me tog gis: bod khams dkar po'i chos la 'khod pa'i phyir: rig 'dzin slob dpon padma spyan drangs tshe: brtan ma bcu gnyis skyong ma 'khor bcas rnams: srog snying phul nas dbang bskur dam la btags: tshe yi dkyil 'khor skyong bar zhal bzhes pas: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: thugs dam rgyud bskul chos min bar chad sol: mtha' yi dmag zlogs nad yams dus 'khrug dang: byad ma dam sri'i snying khrag zhal du rol: chos mdzad dam ldan rnal 'byor grogs mdzod la: bsam pa'i don rnams ma lus myur 'grub par: rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod: gtor bro ni: gtor gzhong ri rab 'bar ba'i 'og: dgra bgegs gnod byed bkug nas kyang: steng du tshe lha'i bro brdungs pas: rjes shul tsam yang med par mdzod: oṃ laṃ āḥlaṃ hūm̐ laṃ dam sri st+waṃ bha ya nan swā hā:

de nas mchod bstod bzod gsol/ dngos grub len pa/ brtan bzhugs gshegs gsol gang 'os/ nyer bsdu lhar ldang bcas gzhung na med phyir spyi ltar bya'o// mchan/ bsngo smon ni: de ltar tshe dpag med mgon bsgrubs pa'i dges: dpal ldan bla ma'i sku tshe brtan pa dang: mkha' mnyam yongs la bde skyid 'byung ba dang: rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog: bkra shis ni: chos sku'i bkra shis rgyal ba tshe dpag med: 'gro ba'i tshe bsod rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog: longs sku'i bkra shis rgyal ba rigs lnga'i dpal: skye rgu'i tshe bsod rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog: sprul sku'i bkra shis rig 'dzin padma 'byung: gdul bya dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog: gsang ba'i yum mchog ye shes mtsho rgyal sogs: rig 'dzin bla ma brgyud pa'i bkra shis shog: tshe bsod rgyas mdzad mkha' 'gro sde bzhi yis: dge legs phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog: bstan dgra sgrol mdzad ye shes mgon po yis: phrin las phyogs mthar rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog: ces brjod me tog sil ma char du dbab: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: gtad rgya: rig 'dzin rnam rgyal rdo rje'am lhun grub rab brtan gyi dag snang ngo*/// /
